notes.title: New Teaser + Demo Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Galactic Agents,

I've just dropped a brand-new demo gameplay teaser
Catch a glimpse of the chaos, the bullets, and the beautifully messy combat that is being cooking up:

[previewyoutube=BZe8AnUOYto;full][/previewyoutube]

And here’s the big news:
The demo will be available to play on June 2!

It’ll be live as part of Steam Next Fest, but now you know exactly when you can get your hands on it.

can't wait for you to dive in and experience it for yourself.
Let me know what you think when you play - your feedback means the galaxy to us.

Wishlist Galactic Pawns if you haven’t yet, and stay tuned!

– Afek
Galactic Agent in Chief
